## Ravenfield VR 1.16.8

- Night vision and other toggled items work from their holster while driving (the press drew the car's horn).
- A second gun's scope no longer draws the whole scene from the holster.
- Big recoil kicks come back in a curve instead of sitting at their limit.
- A round taken from the pouch, picked up or put back has a sound, and a light's switch has a proper click.
- A magnifier's hand takes a grip pose while flipping it.
- A grenade let go dead still leaves along the hand.
- Memory: only the sounds the mod uses are held, so levels' music and ambience can be unloaded between maps; stand-in magazines free their collision mesh.
- Launcher: a graphics preset it cannot write no longer stops the game from starting.
- Setup: an unreadable Steam file no longer stops the command-line uninstall, and its last message only points at Steam's Play entry when it was added.
